claims.question: What RDB format version does Redis 7.4/8.x write?
What is the highest Redis version whose RDB/replication stream Valkey can load?
What RDB version number does Valkey 9.0/9.1 write?
claims.skill_answer: v80, its own numbering, loadable only by Valkey 9

claims.question: What does a Valkey replica do with its existing dataset before discovering an incoming RDB is unreadable?
claims.skill_answer: It flushes its own dataset first (valkey-io/valkey#2588)

claims.question: What redis_version does Valkey report in INFO, and where is the real version?
claims.skill_answer: Hardcoded redis_version:7.2.4; real version in valkey_version

claims.question: In which Valkey release was the dual-channel replication + Sentinel phantom-replica bug (#2338) fixed?
claims.skill_answer: Valkey 9.1.0 only; below that set dual-channel-replication-enabled no
